    20h

    I got passed over for promotion last year It stung for about a week. Then I asked my manager one question What would you need to see from me? She wrote down four things on a napkin. None of them were about working harder All of them were about being visible. I kept the napkin in my wallet. I shared my work in every weekly review. I asked for the projects nobody else wanted. I did those four things for six months. Last Friday I got the job 🎉

    We lost our biggest customer today.

    Nobody on the team saw it coming.

    The warning signs were all there.

    Their invoices were paid later each month.

    Their champion left in the spring.

    Their usage halved over the summer.

    We had dashboards for all of it.

    Every one of them was red by June.

    I kept telling myself they were busy.

    Busy customers do not stop logging in.

    Nobody was asked to look at them.

    That part is entirely on me.

    Tomorrow we start calling every single account.
